$Comment: What a player sees and hears when a loot table pays them one of its rare rolls: a toast and a chime.
Any roll (or ladder floor) in a Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables file can carry "Cue": "Rare_Find",
and the cue fires only when the rewards beside it really paid out, so it never celebrates an empty
hand. The cue id is the moment id: write another Cue value and a moment file of that name, and that
roll gets a moment of its own with no code.
This is the library's own neutral default, so a rare roll is heard on a server running the library
alone. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its own pack replaces it, and a server owner
can do the same from the owner layer. Override the whole file rather than editing this one.
The moment carries 'player' (who the table paid). It fires for whatever rare roll named it, so the
words are about the find, not one item: the item itself arrives with its own pickup notice. Add a
Broadcast group to tell the whole server, or a Command to run something beside the toast.
